results.title: Kasseh Market sweepers begin strike over three months’ unpaid salaries
results.content: About 27 sweepers at the Kasseh Market in the Ada East District of the Greater Accra Region have embarked on an indefinite strike over three months of unpaid salaries.

results.title: ORC moves to strike off 453 companies, dissolves 323 others
results.content: The Office of the Registrar of Companies (ORC) has announced plans to remove 453 companies from Ghana’s Companies Register, while confirming the dissolution of another 323 entities whose names have already been struck off.

results.title: Interior Minister visits injured GIS Officer at 37 Military Hospital following Hamile explosion
results.content: The Minister for the Interior, Alhaji Muntaka Mohammed-Mubarak, has visited the 37 Military Hospital in Accra to assess the condition of a Ghana Immigration Service (GIS) officer critically injured in an explosion at Hamile in the Upper West Region.

results.title: CHOGM: King Charles describes slave trade as shameful chapter of history
results.content: King Charles III of the United Kingdom and Head of the Commonwealth has described the slave trade as a shameful chapter of human history.

results.title: Farmer found dead with gunshot wound in Assin Ketukrom
results.content: Police have launched an investigation into the death of a 56-year-old farmer whose body was discovered in a room at Assin Ketukrom in the Assin North District of the Central Region, with a suspected gunshot wound to the abdomen.

results.title: Agalga plans visit to detained Kwame Frimpong amid extradition proceedings
results.content: Majority Leader James Agalga plans to visit detained Asante Akyem North MP Ohene Kwame Frimpong to get firsthand information about his case as extradition proceedings continue in the Netherlands.

results.title: Kwakye Ofosu cuts sod for construction of new classrooms in AAK
results.content: Felix Kwakye Ofosu, the Member of Parliament (MP) for the Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese (AAK) Constituency, has initiated steps to address the persistent challenge of inadequate classroom infrastructure in some communities within the constituency.

results.title: 2027 Budget must prioritise tourism development – Consultant
results.content: Emmanuel Frimpong, a tourism consultant, has urged the government to prioritise funding and implementation of tourism, arts and culture projects in the 2027 Budget to drive investment, create jobs and boost economic growth.

results.title: Mahama holds bilateral talks with WTO Director-General
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has held bilateral talks with Dr Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, the Director-General of the World Trade Organisation (WTO), on the margins of the ongoing 28th Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) in St. John’s, Antigua and Barbuda.

results.title: 2026 tourism budget implementation promising, but incomplete – Analyst
results.content: Emmanuel Frimpong, a Tourism Consultant and Analyst, says Ghana’s implementation of tourism, arts and culture initiatives outlined in the 2026 Budget has been promising but remains incomplete.

results.title: Africa urged to unite on digital governance agenda
results.content: African countries must forge a common digital governance agenda to bridge the digital divide and safeguard the continent’s future, Vice President Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has said.

results.title: Ablakwa calls for global financial reforms, resource sovereignty
results.content: Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, on Wednesday called on Commonwealth member countries to champion reforms in the global financial architecture to address systemic inequalities confronting developing countries, particularly those in the Global South.

results.title: Mahama, Carney explore expanded cooperation in energy, minerals and trade
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney have discussed ways to deepen diplomatic and economic ties between Ghana and Canada, with particular attention to energy, critical minerals, trade and development.

results.title: TraffiTech-GH: ‘If fines are too expensive, don’t overspeed’ – Mahama to motorists
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has told motorists unhappy with the penalties under the newly introduced TraffiTech-GH traffic enforcement system to avoid speeding rather than complain about the cost of fines.

results.title: How Absa is connecting affluent banking with lifestyle experiences
results.content: While access to credit, investment solutions, and everyday banking services remain important, many affluent customers also seek convenience, access, and experiences that complement their lifestyles.

results.title: Telecel champions inclusivity at Disability Inclusive Hackathon 2026
results.content: Telecel Ghana participated in this year's Disability Inclusive Hackathon (DI-HACKATHON), organised by the Inclusive Tech Group and the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) Ghana Section

results.title: ‘He’s innocent until proven guilty’ – Agalga says Parliament united on Kwame Frimpong’s rights
results.content: Majority Leader James Agalga says Parliament is united on protecting detained Asante Akyem North MP Ohene Kwame Frimpong’s rights, insisting he must be presumed innocent.

results.title: Too many schoolchildren dying on our roads – Mahama backs TraffiTech
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has defended the introduction of the TraffiTech-GH speed enforcement system, citing the deaths and life-changing injuries suffered by schoolchildren knocked down by speeding vehicles as a compelling reason for stricter traffic regulation.

results.title: Agalga rules out declaring detained Asante Akyem North MP’s seat vacant
results.content: Majority Leader James Agalga has ruled out declaring the Asante Akyem North parliamentary seat vacant over the detention of its MP, Ohene Kwame Frimpong, in the Netherlands.

results.title: Smart farming, weak connections: Rethinking rural connectivity in Ghana
results.content: Farming involves a succession of decisions. Is the soil dry enough to need watering?

results.title: Morocco says it will uphold Western Sahara ceasefire after UN mission ends
results.content: Morocco will remain committed to the ceasefire in Western Sahara even after the United Nations peacekeeping mission in the territory ends, the Royal Palace said on Wednesday.

results.title: Agalga rejects claims Mahama has shifted position on LGBTQ bill
results.content: Majority Leader James Agalga has rejected claims that President John Mahama has changed his position on the LGBTQ bill. He says errors in the legislation have held up its transmission to the Presidency.

results.title: ‘Absolutely’ – Agalga confirms LGBTQ bill will reach Mahama this month
results.content: Majority Leader James Agalga says the LGBTQ bill will reach President John Dramani Mahama this month, after Parliament corrects errors in its penalty provisions.

results.title: TraffiTech-GH: Mahama directs installation of speed camera warning signs for transparency
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has directed the authorities implementing the TraffiTech-GH traffic enforcement system to install clear warning signs ahead of speed camera locations to alert motorists and promote transparency.

results.title: Parliament to reverse LGBTQ bill’s passage over errors in penalties – Agalga
results.content: Parliament will rescind the passage of the anti-LGBTQ bill to correct errors in its penalty provisions, Majority Leader James Agalga has disclosed.

results.title: Iran’s chief negotiator says Americans voted ‘no to war’
results.content: Iran's chief negotiator in talks with the US has said that Americans voted "NO TO WAR", after President Donald Trump's Republican Party suffered a stunning defeat in the midterm elections.

results.title: Real Madrid reach verbal agreement to sign Gabriel
results.content: Real Madrid are confident they can win the race to sign Manchester United forward JJ Gabriel after reaching a verbal agreement with the teenager.

results.title: Agalga defends Ablakwa over interdiction of passport scandal suspect
results.content: Majority Leader in Parliament, James Agalga, has defended Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa over allegations of irregularities in the issuance of Ghanaian service passports, saying the minister acted appropriately by interdicting an officer implicated in the matter to allow investigations to proceed.

results.title: Strong winds uproot historic tree Okomfo Anokye planted many years ago at Agona
results.content: Strong winds have uprooted the historic tree planted by the legendary priest Okomfo Anokye at Agona in the Ashanti Region.

results.title: 2027 Budget won’t get rubber-stamp treatment by supermajority – Agalga
results.content: Majority Leader in Parliament, James Agalga, has dismissed suggestions that the governing National Democratic Congress' (NDC) numerical strength in the House could undermine parliamentary scrutiny of the 2027 Budget, insisting that the legislature will not abandon its oversight responsibilities.
